title: Final Formula Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive the lens makers' formula and the achromatic lens equation.

title: Correct Application of Derivatives
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply derivatives to the focal length equations with respect to wavelength.

title: Understanding of Focal Lengths
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate understanding of how the focal lengths of the crown and flint lenses relate to the achromatic condition.

title: Sign and Condition Checks
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check the signs of the focal lengths and confirm the conditions for convergence.

title: Common Errors in Derivation
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the derivation steps.

title: Final Conditions Verification
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state and justify the conditions f_c > 0 and f_t < 0 for the lenses.

title: Clarity of Explanation
description: Optional Criteria: The student should provide clear and logical explanations throughout their derivation and reasoning.
